---
name: Docs Improvement
about: Report something confusing, missing, or wrong in the documentation
labels: documentation
---

## Which Document

File path or URL. (e.g., `docs/getting-started.md`, `plugins/coordinator/CLAUDE.md`)

## What's Confusing or Wrong

Describe the problem — incorrect claim, missing step, unclear phrasing, broken link, etc.

## Suggested Fix

What should it say instead? A draft is welcome but not required.

## Additional Context

Anything else — the task you were trying to complete, what led you to the doc, etc.
